title: PING / Local Pet 01 — Open Production Room
dek: Five little signals, one honest build ledger, and a physical companion that does not exist until the evidence says it does
body:
PING / Local Pet 01 is the first narrow production object inside the wider LOCAL STAR and digital-pets work: a palm-sized companion that lets trusted adults exchange HOME, HELLO, OPEN, OKAY, and KNOCK without opening a chat thread.

The public production room begins with a browser-only rehearsal and then shows the build truth. No physical units exist. No components have been ordered. No vendor quote, funding commitment, application submission, preorder, certified radio path, satellite service, or partner announcement exists.

What does exist is a frozen V1 product boundary, a 34-row verification matrix, a corrected Alpha planning BOM, a mapped 25-mile production ring around El Segundo, a staged capital plan, and a transport-independent firmware core. Forty-seven normal and sanitizer host tests cover compose, route, retry, expiry, acknowledgement, replay, relay, queue persistence, restart recovery, pairing, the candidate security boundary, and bounded radio frames. Protocol V3 uses a 168-byte transport envelope that keeps the signal code in ciphertext and adds a P-256 origin signature plus relay-integrity tag. A hundred fresh host ceremonies agree on separate content and relay roots while rejecting MITM, tamper, replay, expiry, self-pair, and rate-limit abuse.

A reproducible ESP-IDF 6.0.1 field target links the PSA crypto and ephemeral ECDH adapters, atomic NVS checkpoint and pairing stores, RAK3172 UART/RUI3 transport, a GPIO mode switch, and fail-closed boot checks. Two clean field builds from source 0208b9bc4ba7d846917ed3b83bee513b792bbc14 produced the same 371,008-byte firmware SHA-256: 57de6283d2f79ee2c835d82952d53951d11102d3606316105c06d4d3c8b1f018. No board has been flashed or provisioned. BLE pairing transport, physical code display and confirmation controls, persistent attempt limiting, manufacturer identity, revocation, secure-element storage, independent review, encrypted-flash runtime, hardware drivers, and physical evidence remain unfinished.

Alpha 0 targets ten working pets plus two spares. The corrected component plan is $3,855 including contingency under an unapproved $4,500 parts ceiling. The exact compute board later showed 600 public DigiKey units, but the selected display fell to seven visible units and RAK3172 stock remains undisclosed. A proposed $1,250 proof-pair wave builds two pets plus high-risk spares before the remaining Alpha order. Public catalog pages are not supplier quotes.

The immediate capital route is a prepared, unsubmitted Boost VC Fellowship application. The live form describes a $50,000 equity investment at a $1.5 million cap. A late Fall 2026 Y Combinator application is an optional $500,000 full-bridge route under YC's published standard deal. Neither has been submitted. Founder identity, video, process and economics decisions, and explicit transmission approval remain release gates.

Interviews are not a gate before Alpha. The product is built, broken, measured, repaired, and published first. A later no-payment 100-unit El Segundo evaluation measures actual activation, pairing, weekly use, delivery, support, privacy, and repair behavior. PING never compensates for failed reliability, security, privacy, or economics with louder promotion.

The target V1 is not an assistant, toy robot, smart speaker, alarm, child companion, or integrated satellite terminal. It is a small designed communication object with visible route truth, no microphone, camera, GPS, mandatory cloud account, or open-ended chat. Any future satellite path belongs to a separate certified gateway.
